The '''''Allegiance''-class battlecruiser''' was a large [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Like other vessels in the long-running [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] design family, it was marked by a distinct wedge-shape.

==Description==
[[File:Naval_Station_Validusia.jpg|thumb|left|Several ''Allegiance''-class battlecruisers docked at [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']].]]

===Dimensions===
The ''Allegiance''-class [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] was similar in appearance to both the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory'']], [[Procursator-class Star Destroyer|''Procursator'']] and [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class]] Star Destroyers, but was larger than all of them, reaching a length of 2,200 meters.<ref name="JFT" /> Unlike the ''Victory'' and the ''Imperial'', the ''Allegiance''-class lacked ventral hangar bays.<ref name="DEI3" /><ref name="EGW" /> Like fellow hangarless models such as the ''Procursator'' and [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class]],<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> the model could seemingly only rely on its own exterior ordnance, as the ''Allegiance'' appeared to be unable to carry any [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] or ground vehicles internally.<ref name="DEI3" /><ref name="EGW" />

The terraced dorsal superstructure that surrounded the ''Allegiance''{{'s}} bridge tower was far smoother than those on the ''Imperial''-class, allowing for better armor coverage and less exposure of the inter-plate surfaces.<ref name="DEI3" /><ref name="EGW" />

===Offensive and defensive systems===
[[File:LaurelAndHardyJoinTheImperialNavy-EGW.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Captain Piett and Admiral Ozzel with three ''Allegiance''-class battlecruisers among a fleet. Visible are the outermost dorsal batteries on the port side of an ''Allegiance''.]]
The ''Allegiance''-class was armed with turreted gun batteries in a similar layout to the dorsal turret guns on the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]],<ref name="SW:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> albeit with an increased number of guns, six instead of four, due to its larger frame.<ref name="EGW" />
The ship also had several cannons situated on the mid-axis of the vessel,<ref name="EGW" /> similar to the batteries located on the mid-axis of the ''Imperial''-class models, as well as 3 similar batteries on each side of the ship.<ref name="TEGTVAV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

===Propulsion systems===
The ''Allegiance''-class battlecruiser had a visible armored reactor bulge on the ventral side of the superstructure, similar to the ''Imperial''<ref name="SW:ICS" /> and the ''Victory''-class.<ref name="TEGTVAV" /> Due to scale, it was more massive than on these contemporary Star Destroyers.<ref name="DEI3" /><ref name="EGW" />

===Bridge tower===
The command tower was T-shaped,<ref name="DEI3" /> like the modular towers produced for many [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] designs.<ref name="SW:CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> It was put in full view of enemy vessels, which made it an easy target for mass-bombardment by an enemy.<ref name="DEI3" /> The ''Allegiance''{{'s}} tower included a visible section that stood out from the rest of the tower,<ref name="EGW" /> similar to the bridge sections on the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="TEGTVAV" /> and the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]].<ref name="SW:CL" /> The tower was capped by geodesic domes,<ref name="DEI3" /><ref name="EGW" /> like on other contemporary Imperial warships.<ref name="TEGTVAV" />

==History==
===Imperial service===
[[File:ImperialFleetRefueling.jpg|thumb|right|150px|An ''Allegiance'' battlecruiser gets [[Altor-class replenishment ship|refueled]] alongside [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|two]] [[Assertor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|dreadnoughts]], another [[Praetor Mark II-class battlecruiser|battlecruiser]] and two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].]]
The ''Allegiance''-class was in service with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. At least one ''Allegiance''-class was a part of a fleet dispatched to [[Battle of Arrochar|bombard]] a [[Arrochar Rebel base|Rebel base]] on the planet [[Arrochar]].<ref name="SW2013" /> During a rendezvous with the elite unit [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], several ''Allegiance''-class battlecruisers formed part of a fleet that was observed by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] and Death Squadron's commander, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]].<ref name="EGW" />

In service, the ''Allegiance'' was known as a "Heavy Star Destroyer" and was noted as being typical of the kind of ship that fit the "Star Cruiser" designation of [[Warship/Legends|warship]]. Due to its size, power and combat focus, the class was afforded the designation of "battlecruiser" by the [[Republic Navy War College/Legends|Republic Navy War College]] at [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]], using their [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|warship classification system]].<ref name="JFT" />
"Star Cruiser", on the other hand, was recognized only by some military historians as a designation for smaller models of battlecruisers.<ref name="EGW" /> The distinction was used by some to separate ships like the ''Allegiance'' from larger battlecruiser models like the [[Praetor Mark II-class battlecruiser|''Praetor Mark II''-class]].<ref name="EGW" />

At some point during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], at least three ships of this class were serviced at the massive [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']]<ref name="EGW" /> in the [[Validusia system/Legends|Validusia system]].<ref name="TEAoc">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The system was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEAoc" /> and its Imperial facilities could maintain several heavy Imperial warships at once, including standard Star Destroyers, battlecruisers like the ''Allegiance,'' large [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|dreadnoughts]] and fleet replenishment ships.<ref name="EGW" />

During a fleet exercise some time after the [[Arms Race]] campaign,<ref name="Arms Race timeframe">Three [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s were seen flying in formation during the refilling procedure, which indicates that it took place after the [[Arms Race]] campaign shown in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], due to the TIE/ad starfighter entering the Imperial Navy after the events of that campaign.</ref> a battlecruiser of this class was refueled by an [[Altor-class replenishment ship|''Altor''-class replenishment ship]], alongside an [[Assertor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought]].<ref name="EGW" />

===The Dark Empire===
[[File:Eclipse_Allegiance.jpg|thumb|left|150px|''Eclipse'' with two ''Allegiance''-class battlecruisers and a third Star Destroyer.]]
''Allegiance''-class battlecruisers were pressed into numerous duties during the time of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] return, including escort duty for even larger [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]]<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="DEI6" /> and providing protection and support for Palpatine's defense forces at [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], as part of the [[Deep Core Security Zone/Legends|Byss Security Zone]].<ref name="DEII4" /> They were used throughout the [[Beshqek system|Beshqek]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] to patrol and monitor traffic to and from the secluded throne-world and worked in conjunction with [[Gauntlet Scanner Station]]s, destroying any ships the stations identified as hostile.<ref name="BATDC">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050414planet2|series=Byss and the Deep Core|text=Part 2: Empress Teta}}</ref>
During this phase of its career, serving in the navy of the [[Dark Empire]], the ''Allegiance''-class was sometimes referred to as "''Imperial''-class" and a "Super Star Destroyer" by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces,<ref name="DEAud">[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]</ref> the former due to its physical resemblance to the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers.

At the [[Battle of Calamari]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the battlecruiser [[Allegiance (Allegiance-class)|''Allegiance'']] served as a command and [[communications ship]] for the invasion fleet at [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and transmitted images back to the command center at [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. A [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] task force picked up the transmissions while in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] transit to the system and homed in on their origin. As the fleet jumped out of hyperspace, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] ordered all ships to fire from his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Emancipator]]''. The fleet bombarded the Imperial battlecruiser and its ''Procursator''-class escorts and destroyed both the ''Allegiance'' and the Star Destroyers. Following the strike, Calrissian's fleet passed by the wreckage of the ''Allegiance'' and began landing their [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] reinforcements.<ref name="DEI3" />

Following the Republic victory at Dac, two ''Allegiance'' battlecruisers escorted Palpatine's flagship, the dreadnought [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']], as it traveled to the [[Cyax system/Legends|Cyax system]] to confront the New Republic leaders.<ref name="DEI6" /> Ships of the class later participated in the [[Battle of the Emperor's Citadel]], the failed attempt by a Republic strike team to infiltrate Byss and topple Palpatine.<ref name="DEII4" />

===End of service===
By the time following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], any ships of the ''Allegiance''-class had presumably all been destroyed or retired, as both the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Fel Empire]] put their naval focus on smaller, lighter designs and no major powers in the galaxy used Super Star Destroyers anymore due to their expensive upkeep.<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Allegianceblow.jpg|thumb|right|210px|The ''Allegiance''{{'s}} command tower exploding during the Battle of Calamari in 10 ABY.]]
The ''Allegiance''-class battlecruiser<ref name="JFT" /> first appeared as the Super Star Destroyer ''Allegiance'' in the [[Dark Empire 3|third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series written by [[Tom Veitch]], illustrated by [[Cam Kennedy]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="DEI3" /> on [[April 21]]st, [[1992]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54059/star_wars_dark_empire_1991_3|text=Star Wars: Dark Empire (1991) #3}}</ref>

The [[Dark Empire (audio drama)|audio drama adaptation of Dark Empire]] refers to a vessel as both an "''Imperial''-class destroyer" and "Super Star Destroyer,"<ref name="DEAud" /> with the corresponding comic panel depicting the ''Allegiance''.<ref name="DEI3" />

The most recent canonical incarnation of the design originated as a detailed fan-made 3D model by [[Ansel Hsiao]], who based his design on the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] ''Allegiance'' from [[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]].<ref name="Fractalsponge original comment">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=227|text=Re: Something big|author=Ansel Hsiao|date=2008-10-14|quote=The doodle was meant as my interpretation of the Allegiance.|archivedate=20230825133527}}</ref> When approached by [[Lucas Licensing]] to provide artwork for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', Hsiao submitted his own designs in addition to new models, along with their names. The names were recorded in LFL's [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Fractalspongecomment1">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=1576|text=Re: Something big|author=Ansel Hsiao|date=2012-02-08|quote=As far as I know, they kept the names for the Holocron at least. Leland Chee was very gracious in letting me use them.|archivedate=20200526055130}}</ref><ref name="JFT" />

[[File:AllegianceModel-Fractalsponge.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ansel Hsiao's model.]]
The use of "heavy" in the class-name on his gallery, was Hsiao's own invention. According to him, it is not part of the canonical name which was submitted to the Lucas Licensing continuity database.<ref name="Fractalsponge comment2">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=1623|text=Re: Something big|author=Ansel Hsiao|date=2012-04-11|quote=Heavy and light are my designations, and not canon, and in any event only refer to relative scale, and are really quite common in normal naval terminology.|archivedate=20200526055233}}</ref> On his Tumblr account detailing endnote trivia in ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', [[Jason Fry]] noted the name as officially being ''Allegiance''-class battlecruiser, and also explicitly identified the unnamed ships in various panels of ''Dark Empire II'' as being the same as the ''Allegiance''-class battlecruisers. In addition, Fry also attributed the name "Heavy Star Destroyer" as a nickname in canon lore and confirmed that the class's specifications were officially recorded.<ref name="JFT" /> On a related note, the ship-class' designation was upgraded from a Star Destroyer to a battlecruiser due to the use of the Anaxes War College System that was created for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''. The [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnought]] had something similar occur, where its ship designation was changed from Star Battlecruiser to dreadnought.

Besides Hsiao's artwork in the book, the design can be seen in another painting, by [[Tommy Lee Edwards]]. The image uses a picture from Hsiao's personal gallery as a background, originally titled "Strategic Reserve,"<ref name="FSG">{{WebCite|url=http://fractalsponge.net/gallery/images/index.html#Strategic%20Reserve.jpg|text=Still Images|author=Ansel Hsiao|archivedate=20200122144507}}</ref> where three members of the ship class appear, although two are cut off by the top edge of Edwards' painting. The third ship is to the right and in close proximity to [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] and [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], facing away.<ref name="Suvudulink">{{Suvudu|subdomain=star-wars|url=2012/04/comparing-battles-can-bring-star-wars-down-to-earth.html/ozzel_piett|text=Comparing Battles Can Bring Star Wars Down To Earth » Ozzel_Piett|author=Tommy Lee Edwards|date=2012-04-07|nobackup=1}} (Hsiao's artwork on a Suvudu EGTW art gallery, second Battlecruiser on the lower left side.)</ref>
